content: type: nature or genre of the content of the document, which, in accordance with the DCMI Type Vocabulary, is Text in all cases and additionally StillImage in cases where a document also contains images. Additionally, the linguistic type is specified according to the OLAC Linguistic Data Type Vocabulary, as either primary_text (applies to most documents) or lexicon in cases where a document represents an entry of a simplified language vocabulary
